cloud_computer_explanation: The Cloud Computer needs nothing installed or connected here. An execution environment starts when a Task begins and is released when it is no longer needed.
cloud_computer_settings_description: This Agent runs on the OpenTag Cloud Computer, which is always online. An execution environment starts when a Task begins.
cloud_discard_description: This releases the environment without saving its latest work. Changes made since the last successful save are lost. The last saved workspace is kept and restored on the next Task.
cloud_discard_stale: This environment changed while this dialog was open. Review the current state before discarding anything.
cloud_environment_runtime_waiting: Waiting for the runtime to connect
cloud_error_release_incomplete: The environment could not be fully released
cloud_error_restore_required: The saved workspace could not be restored
cloud_error_save_failed: The workspace could not be saved
cloud_error_start_failed: The environment could not be started
cloud_error_start_unconfirmed: Environment startup could not be confirmed
cloud_notice_conflict: The environment changed before the request completed. Check the current state before trying again.
cloud_notice_unconfirmed: The release result could not be confirmed. The current state is being re-read — check it before trying again.
cloud_outcome_released_discarded: Environment released. Unsaved changes were discarded.
cloud_outcome_released_saved: Environment released. The saved workspace is restored on the next Task.
cloud_outcome_releasing: The request returned. Check the current environment state.
cloud_overview_empty: No Session has a Cloud environment yet. An environment starts when the first Task begins.
cloud_overview_unavailable: The Cloud environment state cannot be confirmed right now. Nothing is shown because no state has been confirmed.
cloud_release_stops_work: Releasing stops current execution before saving the workspace.
cloud_sessions_load_more_failed: More Sessions could not be loaded.
cloud_task_environment_none: This Task has no Cloud environment yet. One starts when work begins.
